title: 2027: APC presidential campaign council visits Olubadan, rallies support for Tinubu
text:
Tompolo donates 32 vehicles in Oyo
Prominent political figures, including former Ondo State Governor, Olusegun Mimiko; former Imo State Governor, Rochas Okorocha, and Niger Delta figure, Government Ekpemupolo, popularly known as Tompolo, yesterday joined members of the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council (APC-PCC) on a courtesy visit to the Olubadan of Ibadanland, Oba Rashidi Ladoja.
The delegation, during the visit to the monarch at his palace in Oke-Aremo, Ibadan North Local Government Area of Oyo State, was led by the Director-General of the campaign council, Abubakar Yari.
Other prominent members of the delegation include former Ogun State Governor, Gbenga Daniel; the President’s Special Adviser on Digital Information, Sunday Dare; and the APC governorship candidate in Oyo State, Sharafadeen Alli.
Meanwhile, Tompolo called on the people of Oyo State to vote massively for Tinubu’s re-election as one of their own.
He appealed, as he donated 32 vehicles to the Movement in Oyo State for grassroots mobilisation.
Members of the Olubadan-in-Council and market women, led by the Iyaloja of Ibadanland, Saratu Konibaje, attended the meeting.
The visit was part of the campaign council’s engagement with traditional rulers and other stakeholders ahead of the 2027 presidential elections.
Tompolo, while speaking through his representative, the Managing Director of Tantita Security Services Nigeria Limited, Kestin Pondi, at the inauguration of the Movement in Oyo State, held at the Liberty Stadium, Ibadan, yesterday, said the vehicles were donated to support the Movement’s campaign, which is aimed at mobilising votes for Tinubu’s re-election, and the election of other candidates under the APC.
He reminded Oyo people that Tinubu is their son and they should ensure that he returns to office to complete the two-term turn of the South, calling on members of the Movement to take the message of the President’s re-election to all parts of the state and that the people of Oyo State should be among those who will back Tinubu for another four years to consolidate his reforms.
Also speaking at the rally, Alli assured that the Oyo APC would put in all efforts to deliver the state.
He thanked Tompolo for his donation and for his support for President Tinubu.
Earlier, the National Coordinator of the PBAT Door-to-Door Movement, Sunday Asuku, called on the people of Oyo State, especially the youths, to firmly support Tinubu’s re-election.
Asuku described the President’s reforms as necessary for the country’s economic growth and sustained development.
